entities.name: Alexander, Margrave of Brandenburg-Ansbach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Christian Frederick Charles Alexander was the last margrave of the two Franconian principalities, Bayreuth and Ansbach, which he sold to the King of Prussia, a fellow member of the House of Hohenzollern.
